The '''JX-09 Secured Prisoner Transport''' was a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] developed by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]].

==Characteristics==
The JX-09 had a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], four [[Security guard/Legends|guards]], and space for up to 20 passengers. It measured 14 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, and was a long, insectile craft built around the chassis of a basic [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder truck]], with four small wings for stabilization. Two flexible mandibles allowed the pilot and guards to remain inside while detaining particularly troublesome subjects.
